items.content: A free alternative to Milanote
NodexMesh

The application is primarily a free and interesting alternative to the well-known Milanote platform.

The goal is to make it available to everyone and easy to run locally using
Docker Compose

NodexMesh
The application will offer many familiar features to make the system pleasant and convenient to use.
It will also include additional tools and quality-of-life features such as:

- Expandable Kanban boards
- Smooth animations and task/item statuses
- Grouping
- An edit bar with extensive customization options
- And much more

The application will remain free, actively developed, and supported, so you can report bugs and expect updates with fixes.
You can also contribute to the project using the project page below:
Feel free to fork the project, improve the code, add useful features or fixes, and submit a Pull Request. Contributions and collaboration are welcome.
All required information, commands, and setup recommendations are available on the project page

NodexMesh is still under active development and continuous improvement. A working demo is currently available to everyone for free and can be opened directly in a browser using the link in the project’s GitHub repository.

All demo data is stored exclusively in the browser’s local storage, so changes and data created in the DEMO version may disappear after some updates.

To reset the data, clear local storage in your browser’s developer tools (F12).
Alternatively, open the user menu in the top-right corner and use the
Reset DEMO
button.
